alterations.description: Deletion of dialogue 'Do ghadi bhari aish to ho jayegi', 'Tum to is tarah keh rahe lio jaise shadlihud admito apni biwi par hi sabr karke baith jaate hain, har aatijaati aurat ko istarah ghoorte hain jaise yahi u iki gimstada biwi mo bhook shadiwadi se nahin mitat fiyans yeh baat hikuchh aur hai; “ baat yeh hai ke aurat aur mard ke milne julne ki pabandine unki sex ko bujhane ke bajaye bhadka diya Hai', and 'Karoden' from dialogue referring to Indian youths.

Deletion of dialogue 'Yeh haseenon ki jhadkiyan jaise phoolon kimaar padti hai'.
Suggestion of embrace between Radha and Harish while talking about 'maang' faded out.
Views of Radha before the mirror replaced with approved shot.
Shots of emphasised bust of Radha in the song 'Yeh dilki majbooriyan' replaced with approved insertions of Harish.
Shekhar's words 'Police walı' replaced with 'pados wali'.
Deletion of Mohindar's words 'ladki nahin aati khich ke' and 'Jana kitne naujwanon ka khoon kiya hoga'.

Second shot of the female dancer in profile in the song 'Dil ki duniya men' and shots of gestures of the male dancer moving his hand from thighs upwards and throwing it at the girls replaced with approved shots.
Bust jerking of the dancer in the beginning of the moonlight dance covered with fade.
View of Radha's emphasised bust as she heaved and, later, looks at the pendulum replaced with approved shots.
Burning pyre scene reduced to a flash.
Street song 'Duniya ke sare ghamon se begana' added during the house shifting scene.
Booking office at the theatre added.
Radha & Harish etc. added in the exterior of the house.
Deletion of reference 'Jawan hai ya buddhi' to the young lady prisoner.
Deletion of dialogue 'Aisi ki taisi'.
Deletion of entire eunuch sequence when Anwar is searching Rohi's house.
Deletion of dialogue 'Gadhe ke Abbajan ki amma jan se ishk kiya hoga'.
Deletion of dialogue 'Bhanwra phool phool par chume bagair nahin reh sakta'.
Swift circular movements in dances when skirt or kamiz goes above knees, baring pyjama or shalwar near thighs replaced with approved shot.
Line 'Angdai le le kar raat ki rani aai' and accompanying picturisation in the song 'Dil se dil ka paimana' replaced with approved shot.
Views of Rohi in her song before the Vizier where bosom is visible or upper slopes are visible during dance replaced with approved shots.
Deletion of dialogue 'Tu is murghe ko phans' and sepoy's words 'Chal chal, tu mero gaath ghumne chal' etc., and scene of lifting lady in arms.
Deletion of dialogue 'Aaj ki raat' from Rohi's sentence to Anwar after he is wounded.
Struggles between the Vizier and the princess reduced.
Battle scenes and sword fighting between Kamran and Vizier reduced.
Deletion of Roshanlal lying in the bed with Mohana.

Deletion from the dance in the song 'Duniya asikihai', Malti dancing when her 'Chaglırs' fall and a shot of dancing girls seated, and a close-up of Malti dancing with the song 'Merlohamniko bulglyo tol' when her bosom is pointedly emphasised.

alterations.description: Deletion of dialogues: 'Jo bethe ko uthn dota hai, utho hulko...', 'Alai kain phuljad yan main -ne jalal aur phuti', 'Mori bogati badshah ko Baath phansi hal', and 'Argo bataiya Mabaraj' and 'Pacho batayango'.
Deletion of sentence 'Aam achhe lagte hon to kyon na khayyen'.

All shots of extremely emphasised bust of Maya (draped in yellow choli) with outlines pointedly brought out in the dance accompanying the song 'Piya mero ane lage', a similar shot after the song, and similar shot when she is lying on bed replaced with approved shots.
Views of emphasised busts of Maya in the dance accompanying the song 'Batiyan soone...' replaced with approved shots.
Views of emphasised busts of Maya dressed in white saree and striped blouse after the performance of the Arti in the temple replaced with approved shots.
The last fight between Rakshasraj and Pradhyumna reduced, omitting the kick and pressing of the feet on the adversary's cheek.
Deletion of reference to Tejkhon being the name of the father according to brother and being the name of the horse according to the sister, and the words 'Kapooro'.
Deletion of words 'Go Away to the place from where you came' and its repetition and the reply 'Just think over, how can I go to the place from whore I came'.
Deletion of torture sequence in which Akhtar's legs are pulled apart to extort information about secret of Ali Baba's wrath.
Deletion of words 'Yel galati kiski ho sukti bal' when Akhtar says, 'Yel mera hum-shakal kaup ho faktu hul'.
Whipping sequence reduced considerably, retaining only one contact shot in each case, and also the outfield shots and effect.
Mad-man's amorous behaviour towards the maid reduced, deleting his advance to her asking her to make him happy, and asking her to jump and her question whether she should jump.
Whipping scene drastically reduced together with the shadowgraph effects.
Torture of Zubelda reduced, omitting all shots of pulling of hair.
Deletion of all views of Mrs. Vale (John's first girl) with the parting between busts and flesh of her bosom exposed.
Deletion of views of Elena, the Mexican girl of Cole with the parting between busts and flesh of her bosom exposed.
Drastically reduced the fight and shooting between Purriyob moon and Cole's man after they set fire to the ranch-house of Parrint.

Considerably reduced the violence and action in the valley perpetrated by Sherill man and Cole's men, omitting altogether the pushing of a man in a burning house and the shooting in cold blood at close range of another near a burning hound.
